name: Skyline Construction · Crane & Earthworks
label: Build, dig and run the crew
description: A 248 × 216 metre construction yard in a city skyline. Erect a 16-floor skyscraper with a 78-metre tower crane, dig deep foundation bays, push real dirt and gravel, load an articulated truck, haul material and grade a new fill platform. A worker crew, shared jobs, large stockpiles, six plant bays, clear lift guides and live machinery dashboards support synchronized multiplayer building.

Open Crew & jobs to assign a worker to digging, loading, hauling, tipping, grading or steel erection. Workers move through this yard and use the shared machines. Take manual control to operate any available machine yourself.
Worker muster and rest area. Follow the pale pedestrian path to the site office and workstations; keep clear of the haul loop and the marked crane lifting envelope.

functionalSettings.prompt: Read PLANT PARKING · Six machine bays

dialogueSettings.text: Park with the implement raised for travel, stop the engine controls and leave a clear route through the central maintenance lane. Six full-size bays are ready for trucks and tracked machines.
Keep the 14 metre haul loop clear. Follow the marked clockwise route to the excavation bays, gravel processing, fill platform and plant parking. Lower the dump body before moving.

North: tower crane and steel assembly. East: starter dig, deep soil cut and gravel extraction. South-east: soil and gravel stockpiles with a graded fill platform. West: crew jobs, workshop and plant parking.

functionalSettings.prompt: Read SOIL WORKS · Dig, push and spread

dialogueSettings.text: The soil cut and soil stockpile contain real material. Dig or push a load, haul it to the fill platform, then grade thin lifts with the blade. Choose a shared job from Crew & jobs or operate the machinery manually.
Gravel starts in the marked live piles. Scoop and load it, tip it on the fill platform or push it with the bulldozer. The pile surface and volume change as material moves.

functionalSettings.prompt: Read Skyline Works · Crane, Earth & Crew

dialogueSettings.text: Build the city skyline in a 248 by 216 metre working yard. Enter the crane with E / Use, choose steel assistance or control the joysticks, and secure beams on the highlighted frame. Earthworks extend east and south: deep soil, loose gravel, stockpiles, a fill platform and full-size haul lanes. Crew & jobs lets workers use the shared machinery while you supervise or take control.

Crane controls: left joystick slews and runs the trolley; right joystick hoists. Lower the hook to the steel supply, attach a load, raise it, slew to the tower and lower onto the highlighted target. The server shares each movement and placed beam with everyone on site.

Park the excavator for its dig cycle, then position the truck five metres east of it to receive material. Drive loaded trucks along the haul loop to a spoil bay or the fill platform. Lower the bulldozer blade to push real soil and gravel. Stop before exiting; use Hide controls to clear the view.

name: Strait of Hormuz · Shipping Academy
label: Gulf shipping · live rivals, cargo terminals & convoy challenges
description: A large shared shipping world inspired by the Strait of Hormuz, with condensed arcade geography: Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman approaches, Qeshm and Hormuz islands, Musandam, six cargo ports and separate inbound and outbound lanes. Connected commercial terminals have open warehouses, cargo supervisors, moving cranes and live AI shipments. Learn balanced loading, manifests, slower loaded handling, unloading and supply trading. Compete with rival shipping companies while completing rewarded delivery contracts and fictional pirate, debris, storm and sea-mine challenges using the connected boat, quest, combat and marketplace systems.

dialogueSettings.text: This condensed arcade world mirrors the Strait of Hormuz: the Persian Gulf lies west, the Gulf of Oman east, with Qeshm and Hormuz islands north and Musandam south. The two lanes keep inbound and outbound traffic apart. Start Dock induction for loading, securing, sailing and unloading. Conditions and hazards are fictional game scenarios.
Delivery rewards add food, parts and tools to your connected marketplace inventory. Use Shipping → Supply exchange to exchange stock for supplies and tools.
